ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Wazuh Security Platform DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL side loading of DLLs that are part of the Wazuh security platform Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\libwazuhshared\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\libwinpthread\\-1\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\"))) AND  NOT (((ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*")) AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\mingw64\\\\bin\\\\libwinpthread\\-1\\\.dll$")))
